verdict.rationale: Evidence shows some policy-adjacent features — Smart Limits on cards, multi-level GL coding, and workspace 'rules' configurable via AI assistant — suggesting the platform supports policy codification, but there's no direct documentation of category/role/context-based approval limits or an explicit auto-approve-vs-exception-routing workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated approval-workflow/policy-engine documentation, evidence of role-based spending limits, evidence of automatic approval routing only exceptions to humans, and independent corroboration that this works as described.
